##### Project general facts

The Views by Ardee Developments presents a contemporary residential offering framed by two elegant towers set atop a landscaped podium. The project comprises 616 residences, including studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, a three-bedroom Sky Collection, and townhouses, with architecture centred around two towers framed by a landscaped podium.

Residents can enjoy a versatile suite of amenities that includes a fully equipped gym and fitness centre, a family‑friendly pool, relaxed lounge areas, a range of cafés and restaurants, retail showrooms and shops, an events venue and dedicated EV charging points, while generous balconies and the podium garden blur the line between indoor comfort and outdoor ambience.

Interiors are finished with a refined palette of limestone‑look porcelain flooring throughout living spaces, taupe laminate cabinetry paired with travertine‑look backsplashes and countertops in kitchens, and light greige wardrobe doors complemented by satin beige marble bathroom tops and Palermo oak laminate doors and frames; each home arrives with a fully equipped kitchen and is offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island hosts Ardee Downtown, a sprawling master‑planned district crafted for family living. The district contains more than four thousand residential units, six hundred thousand square feet of mall and retail space and over fifty food and beverage outlets, including signature restaurants and luxury hotel accommodation. A promenade of roughly one kilometre winds along the waterfront, encouraging leisurely walks.

The reclaimed island stretches across two point seven million square metres and boasts a sandy shoreline of nearly eight kilometres. Its masterplan anticipates eight thousand five hundred hotel rooms and eighteen thousand six hundred residential units, underpinning a vibrant tourism and living hub. Projected employment exceeds sixteen thousand jobs, reinforcing its role as a major economic catalyst.

Residents enjoy direct access to pristine beaches, waterfront promenades and a collection of upscale hotels and resorts. A diverse array of dining and leisure destinations line the coast, offering everything from casual cafés to gourmet experiences. Connectivity is enhanced by Ras Al Khaimah’s expanding airport facilities and the forthcoming Etihad Rail link, ensuring seamless travel across the Emirates.
